preamble: Lateralization of the alveolar sibilant [s] to the voiceless lateral fricative [ɬ]. In several southern Sinitic groups Middle Chinese *s- became [ɬ]: the Siyi and Gao-Yang Yue varieties (Taishanese, Yangjiang), Nanning Cantonese and Southern Pinghua, and, independently, Puxian Min of Fujian (三 'three' MC sam > Taishanese ɬam³³, Putian ɬɒ⁵³³; Guangzhou Cantonese keeps saam1). Outside Asia, Guatuso (Maléku, Chibchan) changed every Proto-Chibchan *s to ɬ, as in /ɬixi/ 'moon'.

examples.note: Puxian Min developed [ɬ] independently of Yue; Youyang has [θ] instead.
Proto-Chibchan *s is ɬ in all positions in Guatuso; Rama and Bribri keep s.
